scope: v25-staging UI on the user's Mac; disposable synthetic fixtures
runtime: Installed Chrome on macOS; test controller uses the existing x86_64 Python environment
changes: Prewarm only the public designer module after selecting a card; honor Save-Data and invalidate session/permission cache.
Read the authenticated shared template in parallel with the module and consume that response in the common studio.
Await a validated paint of the current canvas before marking editorReady; photo readiness remains separate.
Defer the initial canvas/full preview until shared data is available, avoiding an unnecessary initial render before the template read.
Avoid constructing the complete Moscow-name trie when no catalogue name can start at any eligible input boundary. Exact names, custom overrides and the complete catalogue remain available.

referenceObservation.source: Earlier native fixture run reported by the parent controller
referenceObservation.limitation: Earlier editorReady semantics did not explicitly await a validated canvas paint. This is context, not an equivalent controlled baseline or an estimated percentage speedup.

measurements.revision: shared current-canvas readiness and deferred initial render, before geographic negative filter
repeat in native 12-test UI suite, before geographic negative filter
final source with geographic negative filter

timingInterpretation: The fixture deliberately holds the module until it has established concurrent template reading; moduleReleaseToObservedPaintedEditorMs measures from releasing that hold.
editorMs measures the application's start-to-current-canvas-ready interval, including its initial fixture hold. Observation and event-loop scheduling make it a different interval.
The template read overlaps module loading; the durations must not all be summed.

The final observation is faster, but module/setup timing and observer delay also vary. The full 1.21-second difference between the last two observations is not attributed solely to the geographic filter.

limits: This does not verify a physical iPhone, Safari or a physical iOS keyboard. Mobile focus was checked against visualViewport at 393x852 and a constrained 393x500 viewport.
The under-10-second observations are local synthetic fixtures, not a complete real paired session through external HTTPS.
scripts/benchmark-phone-designer.py can measure real public HTTPS HTML/module transfer with intercepted synthetic APIs. It explicitly reports realUserSessionAcceptance=false.
Real gallery delivery, actual saved branding/maps, phone hardware and external-network variance can add time. RCN-287 live-session acceptance is not claimed here.
